entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikola Kalinić Kalina is a Serbian professional basketball player for Crvena zvezda of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He is also a former Serbian national basketball team player. He is a 2.03 m tall small forward and he is often considered as one of the best players at his position within European basketball.
